title: Can you even tell left from right? Presenting a new challenge for VQA (Under revision in pattern recognition letters)
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The benchmark (UOUC dataset) is designed to evaluate compositional generalisation in Visual Question Answering models.
findings: The paper contains no findings related to religion as it is not a focus of the research.
